Tooltip_MinidoracatKnoxPass_Tag:
Install it from the vehicle mechanics panel under the "Knox Pass" category
(needs the car key or an unlocked door); it charges from the vehicle.
Register the vehicle at a Knox Pass Gate Reader so that gate opens for it.
Tooltip_MinidoracatKnoxPass_Reader:
Right-click a gate with a screwdriver to install it.
Right-click the gate again to manage registered vehicles and the optional lock.
Tooltip_MinidoracatKnoxPass_BarrierKit:
Place it across a road from the build menu (rotate to switch direction);
it takes 4 tiles: the cabinet plus 3 lane tiles.
The barrier has a built-in reader owned by whoever builds it
and follows the reader's power rule.
Dismantle the cabinet to get the kit back.
Tooltip_MinidoracatKnoxPass_WatchModule:
Install it in a Map Watch, then register it at a gate reader.
After that the gate opens by itself when you walk toward it or drive past.
Requires the Minidoracat Map Watch.
